about: money owed that {name} would rather no one knew about
text: {name} owes {creditor} a good deal more than the business has made, and has been paying it down in small sums, hoping no one notices how thin things are.
cover: Business is fine, thank you. Never better.

about: a loan that is not as small as it looks
text: {name} borrowed from {creditor} to keep the doors open, and the loan has grown. A bad month would finish them.
cover: I pay my way. Always have.

text: {name} is one of them: a member of a gang that passes for an honest {job} in daylight. The coin from it keeps the doors open.
cover: I'm an honest {job}. Ask anyone in town.

about: something {name} did that is not spoken of
text: {fact}. No one was ever charged, and {name} would like to keep it that way.
cover: I don't know what you've heard, but it isn't true.

text: {fact}. They have built a life on people not knowing.
cover: I've always lived here. I'm nobody special.

text: {fact}. They said nothing, because it would have cost them more than it was worth.
cover: I didn't see anything. I was busy elsewhere.

text: {fact}. They don't speak of it, and it is the reason they are the way they are.
cover: That's long past, and not for strangers.

text: {fact}. They have done it for years, and are sure no one has noticed.
cover: I've never cheated anyone in my life.
